description: Submit a buyer inquiry/lead directly to a participating dealership for a specific vehicle or general inventory inquiry. Requires explicit buyer consent (consent=true) and at least one contact method (buyer_email or buyer_phone). Returns a lead_id and delivery status.

buyer_email.description: Buyer's email address (at least one of buyer_email or buyer_phone is required).

buyer_name.description: Full name of the prospective buyer.

buyer_phone.description: Buyer's phone number (at least one of buyer_email or buyer_phone is required).

consent.description: Explicit buyer consent flag. Must be true to create and deliver the lead to the dealership.

dealer_id.description: Dealer ID (optional if vehicle_id is provided; required for general dealer inquiries).

message.description: Buyer's intent, questions, test-drive request, or trade-in/insurance notes.

vehicle_id.description: Vehicle ID or 17-character VIN the buyer is inquiring about.

name: submit_lead
title: Submit Qualified Buyer Lead to Dealership
